claims.claim: Normal PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, direct-candidate, and REPAIR allocation now reserves validated local and canonical remote task RUN identities and fails closed on conflicting terminal refs before RUN persistence or Executor invocation.

Added `aios recover-primary <RUN_ID>` to validate an exact conflicting PRIMARY lineage and immutable successful candidate, then allocate a fresh RUN in an isolated historical worktree without modifying the control repository or invoking an Executor/model.

Recovery discards historical evidence attribution, preserves validated completion claims and repository truth, and uses ordinary Runtime completion to execute historical verification once and emit fresh RUN-bound evidence and reviewable transport lineage.
Added deterministic operator and transport regressions plus README documentation without schema, review-authority, verification-ownership, or publication-authority changes.
